newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Klabin still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Klabin still a buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian paper producer Klabin.
-- "Our buy recommendation contemplates a price target for 1997 of 1.250 reais, an upside potential of 30 percent," it said in a report.

-- Klabin is Latin America's largest paper concern and is increasing its production by 10-20 percent in 1998, the report said. The company has strong operating fundamentals and is an excellent proxy for Brazil due to its diversification into consumer goods and industry sectors.
-- Klabin preferred was flat at 0.97 reais in afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bourse.
